module: Runs the lifecycle hooks of a route (onEnter, onMount, onLeave...) for the router. It resolves the function reference declared on the route node (via ui/router/utils), calls the hook under pcall with (context, toRoute, fromRoute, data) and logs errors without interrupting the router.
notes: runLifecycleHook returns (ok, error, isHardError). A missing hook counts as a success. A reference resolution error can be "hard" (isHard, defined by Utils.resolveFunctionReference): the router then aborts the navigation (lifecycle_hook_error); an exception thrown in the hook is never hard.
Empty error messages are replaced by "unknown_error".

sanitizeError.desc: Returns the error if it is a non-empty string, otherwise "unknown_error".

resolveHook.desc: Resolves the hook function hookName on the route node (via Utils.resolveFunctionReference, with a label "Lifecycle hook X on route Y"). Returns nil, nil, nil if the route or the hook is absent.

returns.desc: true if the resolution error is hard.

runLifecycleHook.desc: Runs the hook under pcall with (context, toRoute, fromRoute, data); logs errors at level E.

returns.desc: true if the hook is absent or succeeded.
true if the error is hard (invalid resolution).
